US Leads China in AI Race, IBM CEO Says Amid Chip Tensions

IBM CEO Arvind Krishna stated that the United States is ahead of China in advanced artificial intelligence research. This assessment comes amid ongoing tensions and actions by the US to tighten regulations on AI chip exports to China, reportedly following an "Nvidia spy scandal." The situation highlights a delicate balance in the US-China competition for AI dominance.
